name_zh: 凯山·丰威汉/老挝革命：社会主义建设与内陆枢纽转型
name_en: Kaysone Phomvihane/Lao Revolution: Socialist Construction & Landlocked Hub Transformation
description_zh: 老挝凯山·丰威汉 (1920-1992) 老挝革命领袖/1975 建国/新经济机制(1986)/市场化/一带一路/中老铁路/万象-万荣高铁/特区/水电出口/咖啡/木材/矿产。核心模式：内陆枢纽转型 — 无海港/土地丰富/邻国包围/中老铁路/湄公河/水电/特区/农业/旅游/从陆锁国变陆联国。体现 M198 内陆枢纽转型 — 以"革命合法性+新经济机制+中老铁路枢纽+湄公河水电"四位一体，在内陆劣势/战争遗毒/贫困/大国博弈中实现陆联国跃升。
description_en: Laos Kaysone Phomvihane (1920-1992) revolutionary leader/1975 founding/New Economic Mechanism (1986)/marketization/BRI/China-Laos Railway/Vientiane-Vang Vieng high speed rail/SEZs/hydro exports/coffee/timber/minerals. Core model: landlocked hub transformation — no ports/land abundant/neighbors encircle/China-Laos Railway/Mekong/hydro/SEZs/agriculture/tourism/from landlocked to land-linked. Exemplifies M198 Landlocked Hub Transformation — quaternity of 'revolutionary legitimacy + new economic mechanism + China-Laos Railway hub + Mekong hydro' achieving land-linked leap amid landlocked disadvantage/war legacy/poverty/great power games.
reason_zh: 老挝非单纯内陆国，而是"革命合法性+新经济机制+铁路枢纽"三位一体转型国家。以革命战争建立合法性，以新经济机制引入市场，以中老铁路打破陆锁。M198 区隔于 M175 水联邦(伊泰普)、M168 资源诅咒(委内瑞拉)、M192 游击解放(莫桑比克)，核心在于"革命即建国+机制即转型+铁路即枢纽"的内陆国家跃升范式。
reason_en: Laos not mere landlocked state but 'revolutionary legitimacy + new economic mechanism + railway hub' trinity transformation state. Revolutionary war built legitimacy, NEM introduced markets, China-Laos Railway broke landlocked status. M198 distinct from M175 Water Federalism (Itaipu), M168 Resource Curse (Venezuela), M192 Guerrilla Liberation (Mozambique), core: 'revolution as founding + mechanism as transformation + railway as hub' landlocked nation leap paradigm.
steps_zh: 革命战争建立合法性：1950s 抗法/1975 建国/凯山/苏发努冯/红王子/巴特寮/越南/中国/苏联支持
新经济机制市场化转型：1986 NEM/私有化/外资/市场定价/农业/林业/矿产/旅游/贫困率 46%→18%
中老铁路打破陆锁：2021 通车/万象-磨丁/昆明-万象/陆联国/物流枢纽/特区/制造/农产品/旅游/区域一体化
湄公河水电与绿色能源：南咪/南特/西布安/水电出口泰国/越南/收入/环保/渔业/沉积物/跨国治理/湄公河委员会
特区与区域融合：金三角/万象赛色塔/万荣/博胶/那廉/中/泰/越/缅/印/跨境/投资/贸易/劳务/旅游
steps_en: Revolutionary war builds legitimacy: 1950s anti-French/1975 founding/Kaysone/Souvanna Phouma/Red Prince/Pathe Lao/Vietnam/China/USSR support
Mekong hydro & green energy: Nam Ngiep/Nam Theun/Xe Bang Fai/hydro exports Thailand/Vietnam/revenue/environment/fisheries/sediment/transboundary governance/MRC
SEZs & regional fusion: Golden Triangle/Vientiane Saysettha/Vang Vieng/Bokeo/Nale/China/Thailand/Vietnam/Myanmar/India cross-border/investment/trade/labor/tourism
expected_zh: 以"革命合法性+新经济机制+铁路枢纽+水电"四位一体，在内陆劣势/战争遗毒/贫困/大国博弈中实现陆联国跃升，为内陆最不发达国家提供转型范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'revolutionary legitimacy + new economic mechanism + railway hub + hydro' achieves land-linked leap amid landlocked disadvantage/war legacy/poverty/great power games, providing transformation paradigm for landlocked LDCs.
